articles.title: Crypto for Advisors: Stablecoins: finance's new rails
articles.snippet: Stablecoins are moving beyond crypto into real-world finance, becoming vital B2B cross-border payment and treasury infrastructure, valued for efficiency, speed and regulatory compliance.

articles.title: Stablecoin-powered neobank Fasset raises $51 million to expand across emerging markets
articles.snippet: The Shariah-compliant digital bank is part of a growing wave of fintech startups building banking and payments services on top of blockchain and stablecoin rails.

articles.title: BlackRock, Janus Henderson tokenized funds get instant redemptions with new $1 billion facility
articles.snippet: A new credit facility by Grove aims to allow instant redemptions into stablecoins from BlackRock's BUIDL and Janus Henderson's money market funds, reducing settlement time from days to instantaneous.

articles.title: Coinbase backs Hyperliquid stablecoin push as DeFi trading volumes climb
articles.snippet: Coinbase will manage USDC liquidity on Hyperliquid, deepening ties with one of crypto’s fastest-growing trading platforms.

articles.title: Bank of England ready to water down 'overly conservative' stablecoin proposals: FT
articles.snippet: Restrictions proposed by the BOE prompted criticism from the crypto industry, which said they risked preventing the U.K. from being competitive in the digital economy.
